meta.title: Image Reader (multimodal relay)
meta.description: When the current model declares text-only input, automatically inject a read_image_details tool: the model passes an image (path/URL/data:URL/attachment digest) plus a question, the plugin relays it to a multimodal vision model configured in Settings, and returns the answer (e.g. button pixel coordinates) verbatim. Visibility follows the model's declared input modalities.
